trigger_summary: state change (brightness attr) on 49 named light entities, for 30s
condition_summary: template: light is on and brightness_pct > 0
household_outcome: When a resident manually adjusts any of 49 lamps/lights, the new brightness is silently remembered per-light so future "usual" commands restore it.

trigger_summary: conversation: help / what can I do / what can I say / what can I control / what room am I in / where am I
household_outcome: Asking a Home Assistant Voice satellite "what can I do here" speaks back the room's actual configured capabilities.

trigger_summary: conversation: ~50 lamps/lights/shades/music/tv phrases (no explicit room slot)
condition_summary: room_resolved not none; per-branch template conditions on spoken text
known_issues: Room/device classification is 100% runtime label-based (label_devices('Lamps')/('Lights')/('AppleTV')) – a dynamic-discovery pattern HTBW intends to replace with setup-time configuration.
household_outcome: Saying "lamps on", "shades close", "music off", "tv on", etc. in any room (no room name needed) acts on that room's lamps/lights/shades/music/TV and speaks a short confirmation first.

trigger_summary: conversation: this is good / that's perfect / remember this / remember lighting / remember volume
household_outcome: Saying "remember this" (or naming lighting/volume explicitly) opt-in-learns the room's current lighting levels and/or Sonos volume as the new "usual" for that room.

trigger_summary: state change on 10 input_text.*_speaker_profile_last_media helpers + media_player.outside_sonos
condition_summary: to_state not empty; excludes pink-noise states
household_outcome: Every time a room's "last media" is captured, a lightweight keyword classifier increments a per-genre counter, powering the templates.yaml "House Top Music Genre" sensor.

trigger_summary: state change (media_title/media_content_id/to:playing) on 11 room Sonos players
condition_summary: state==playing; area_id resolvable; excludes pink noise
household_outcome: Whenever a room's Sonos starts/changes playback, the room's last-media text helper is updated and a genre is determined (local rules, else AI Task) for later "what's playing" / "why did you play this" queries.
Saying "play music" in a room starts that room's usual preset or resumes the last-played source at the learned volume.
Saying "continue playing" resumes paused music, restarts idle music from usual defaults, or politely says nothing is queued.

trigger_summary: conversation: ~30 music follow-up phrases incl. genre names, artist {slot}, "what's playing", "why did you play this"
scripts_called: script.continue_playing_room; script.surprise_me_room; script.play_genre_room; script.play_artist_room; script.whats_playing_room (BROKEN – no such script; correct target is script.what_s_playing_room); script.why_did_you_play_this_room

household_outcome: Follow-up music phrases spoken without re-stating the room (stop/pause/resume/surprise me/play a genre/play an artist/what's playing/why did you play this) are routed to the matching room-aware script.

alias: Learn Music Volume – On Sonos Change
trigger_summary: state change of volume_level on 11 room Sonos players
condition_summary: volume delta > 0.03; state==playing (checked again after 5s delay)
household_outcome: Manually adjusting a room's Sonos volume while music plays is remembered as that room's new usual music volume (debounced 5s).

condition_summary: room_resolved not none; shade_percent parsed 0-100; target_covers not empty
household_outcome: Saying an explicit shade/blind percentage in a room sets that room's shade covers to that position and confirms verbally.

condition_summary: room_resolved not none; brightness_pct parsed 0-100; target_lights not empty
known_issues: Runtime label-based lamp/light classification (same pattern as Follow-Up Commands).
household_outcome: Saying an explicit brightness percentage for lamps or lights in a room sets that room's lamps or overhead lights to that level.

condition_summary: bedroom resolved from trigger_area (Primary/Guest Bedroom or Bathroom); else invalid
household_outcome: Saying "Bedtime" in a bedroom or its bathroom starts the soft bedtime routine for that bedroom; said elsewhere, it politely declines.
Saying "Goodnight" in a bedroom or its bathroom runs the terminal, mostly-silent goodnight routine for that bedroom.

known_issues: Description states this is "the authoritative posture transition to awake" yet posture is written by the downstream script, not this automation directly – confirmed consistent, not a defect.
household_outcome: Saying "Good Morning" in a bedroom or its bathroom runs the morning activation routine (shades, bathroom lights/fan, weather) for that bedroom.

alias: Duck Sonos When Any Assist Satellite Is Listening
trigger_summary: state change to 'listening' on 13 assist_satellite entities (11 rooms + 1 alt office entity)
household_outcome: The moment any room's Home Assistant Voice satellite starts listening, that room's Sonos (excluding Beam/TV-audio devices) is ducked and restored afterward so the Home can hear the person over music.

trigger_summary: conversation: what can this room monitor/sense, what sensors are in this room, etc.
household_outcome: Asking what a room can monitor speaks back inferred sensing capabilities (presence, environment, air quality, noise) for that room only.
Asking "what's the temperature" (or humidity/brightness/air quality/noise) in a room speaks the reading if the room has that sensing capability, else a graceful refusal.
